query: Please implement a web application based on static web pages to display and manage data. The application should have functionalities such as data rendering, dynamic style rendering, data caching, page performance optimization, and browser compatibility resolution. Users should be able to browse and manage data, and the application should be able to render and update data based on the API interfaces provided by the backend. Use light yellow in the background layer and dark khaki for the component layer.
